summary: Tree-shaded car park beside a golf course; no homes within 50 m.
reasons: Enclosed by trees and golf course

best_section.where: South-west side of the shaded car park, along the golf course edge

drivers.seclusion: Dense tree canopy on three sides and open golf course to the south-west. Only mapped building is a small non-residential structure 55 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with painted bays, connected to a larger car park and road to the north-west. Cars parked, so a vehicle can reach it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side car park off Meiers Road; little passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Mapped public car park; a few cars and trailers in the adjoining lot suggest regular use.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, Brisbane River 104 m away
Heavy shade may hide bay layout and ground condition
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy, mostly from the east and north; open to the south-west over the golf course.
cannot_judge: Golf club or council overnight restrictions
